effectSummary.ko: 길이 12m·폭 0.8m의 창으로 최대 5명에게 D90% 번개 피해를 주고 지정 지점에 접지창 하나를 6초간 남깁니다. M03이 4m 안의 다음 적을 찾지 못하면 접지창까지 4m, 창에서 다음 적까지 4m를 잇습니다. 벽·감지 규칙을 지키며 창도 연쇄 횟수 하나를 소비합니다. 한 연쇄당 중계 한 번, 마나 4 회복 한 번입니다. 최근 M03 적중 대상을 창으로 직접 맞혀도 같은 회복을 시전당 한 번 얻습니다.
effectSummary.en: Pierce up to 5 enemies along a 12m, 0.8m-wide line for D90% lightning damage and leave one grounding spear at the aim point for 6s. When M03 finds no next enemy within 4m, bridge through the spear with up to 4m on each leg. Obey walls and perception; the spear consumes one chain hop. One relay and one 4-mana refund per chain. Direct spear hits on a recent M03 target also refund once per spear cast.

prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for M12 (Mage). Main subject: one tall dark metal spear planted into a compact arcane grounding rune, two thick branching violet-white lightning bolts bridging to separate small charged stones on either side, spear is a relay node. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.

notes.ko: 새 전투 컨셉의 주체와 방향이 64px에서도 구별됩니다. 밝은·어두운 배경에서 투명 여백과 내부 빈 공간, 주요 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: The new mechanic silhouette and direction remain distinct at 64px. Reviewed transparent margins, internal gaps and primary shapes on light and dark backgrounds.

reuseReason: Existing GlobalHUD icons are 256px line symbols with UI plates, unsuitable as these 1024px painterly masters.
